train_BertForRetrieverSP: train a BertForRetrieverSP model using submitit with gradient accumulation and FP16 support
checkpoint_TrainerState: save and load a TrainerState checkpoint to resume training from a previous epoch
eval_MRR: evaluate the retriever model on a test set and compute MRR and accuracy metrics
init_Trainer: initialize a Trainer with train and cluster config for distributed hyperparameter tuning
log_training_metrics: log training metrics like MRR and smoothed loss to a JSON file per epoch
